LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Startin: Enable starting value protection for mechanoid mechanitors

When enabled, starting with the mechanoid mechanitor scenario adds a hidden health condition to mechanoid mechanitors to reduce their value. The reduction decreases over time. This helps maintain balance when starting mechanoids have a high value.
Add starting value protection to other mechanoids
When enabled, starting with the mechanoid mechanitor scenario also adds a hidden health condition to other mechanoids to reduce their value.
